paragraphs: On Saturday, we have a trip to Grandpa's farm. Dad has our tickets for the train. The train leaves the station at a quarter to nine. The driver is a woman in a blue hat. She says hello to every child. Lily sits next to the window. I never sleep on a train. I look at the green fields all the time. The train stops at five to ten.

Grandpa waits for us at the station. He has his old red tractor. "Jump up!" he says. Grandpa is the driver of the tractor. It is old, but it is very strong. We ride to the farm at ten o'clock. Lily laughs because the tractor goes up and down. The wind is in our hair. "Hold on!" says Dad.

Here is our plan for the day. I write the times in my book. At twelve o'clock, we eat lunch. At half past one, we feed the chickens. At twenty past three, we walk in the fields. The train home leaves at ten past five. We never want to go home! Do you like farms? I do, because I can help Grandpa.
text.summary: Tom writes the plan for the family trip to Grandpa's farm. He lists each time, from the train to the tractor ride and home.
